thread:
dennis-support: FYI customer reported a sudden 5xx + timeouts right after today's small rollout.

sarah: which rollout? route/seed flip?

dennis-support: canary id 2026-03-seed-11. Flip at 12:02 UTC. Spike at 12:05. Errors are 502/504 from gateway.

kp-ops: grabbing logs, gimme a sec :eyes: 

mike: metrics show p50 stable but p95 token latency up and error rate up to 12% on hostpool-us-west-2

lin: any auth failures in the traces or just gateway timeouts?

dennis-support: mix — some 401s, but most are 504s. Customers hitting streaming endpoints see ``ERR_STREAM_RESET`` in client logs.

amelia: can you paste a curl repro?

dennis-support: sure

```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
# response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
# body: "upstream read timeout"
```

kp-ops: seeing 504s with upstream id `runtime-87` in our traces. That runtime started serving the canary variant.

deploy-bot: note: canary rollout 2026-03-seed-11 reached 8% at 12:02, 20% at 12:04.

sarah: 8->20% between 12:02-12:04, spike aligns. We should pause/rollback. @oncall-bot can you abort canary?

oncall-bot: abort initiated by sarah at 12:18 UTC — traffic rollback to baseline variant started.

mike: before rollback completes, need root cause. I pulled a pod log: lots of `kvcache miss` warnings then `allocation failed` and long GC pauses.

lin: config change in this canary enabled `route_affinity: sticky` to improve cache hits. Could be causing hotlining of a subset of instances.

amelia: that flag was supposed to be scoped to dedicated pools only, not hosted. Looks like selector mismatch in the rollout manifest.

dennis-support: customers on hosted saw 5xx, dedicated customers unaffected.

kp-ops: reproducing locally by toggling `route_affinity: sticky` on a small runtime replicates 504s under moderate load.

mike: hypothesis: sticky routing concentrated KV-cache pressure + new kernel path for quantized model -> memory pressure -> timeouts

sarah: action items: 1) finish rollback (in progress), 2) patch rollout selectors to exclude hosted, 3) run controlled canary against dedicated only, 4) customer outreach.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 12:26 UTC. Traffic back to 100% baseline.

dennis-support: customers notified of mitigation. Some still reporting delayed responses — maybe due to in-flight requests.

lin: adding a short-lived shedder rule to drop new sticky sessions and clear hot caches across affected runtime group.

amelia: I'll prep a tiny fix MR to ensure `route_affinity` default is `off` for hosted env and add automated selector tests.

kp-ops: we'll also add an alert for sudden skew in request distribution across instances (p95 load delta > 3x) so we catch sticky-affinity fallout earlier.

sarah: who will own postmortem and timeline? @mike you ok to take lead with ops and support notes?

mike: I can lead. I'll assemble timeline, logs, repro steps, and RCA draft.

dennis-support: if anyone has raw traces or customer error logs, drop them in the incident thread doc link: https://redwood.incidents/1758642000

oncall-bot: incident severity downgraded to S2 at 12:40 UTC after rollback and shedder changes.

amelia: MR ID 9876 created: `fix(route): restrict route_affinity to dedicated pools` — testing now.

sarah: good. we'll follow up with customers and postmortem. thanks all :thumbsup:
